The '''MS-4 twin blaster cannon''' was the primary weapon of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. Manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]],<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> the blaster cannon was powerful enough to blast apart [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and destroy other walkers.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
